model_annotations.English: The bar chart represents the sensitivity across various block indices, categorized into two distinct states. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Block Index" and displays sequentially ordered numerical ticks at 0, 6, 13, 20, and 27. The vertical value axis is labeled "Sensitivity" and utilizes a logarithmic scale ranging from $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-3}$, featuring major tick labels at each power of ten ($10^{-5}$, $10^{-4}$, $10^{-3}$) accompanied by dashed horizontal grid lines. A legend in the top-left corner defines the color coding of the individual vertical bars: blue indicates "4-Fbit" and green indicates "2-Fbit". The bars are sequentially sorted from left to right in ascending numerical order of the block indices. Blue "4-Fbit" bars are positioned at index 0, indices 13 and 14, and continuously from index 19 through 27, while green "2-Fbit" bars occupy the remaining intermediate positions. The shortest bars, representing green "2-Fbit" blocks, are located around indices 4 and 8 with values resting exactly on the $10^{-5}$ baseline. The tallest bar, a blue "4-Fbit" block, is located at index 27 on the far right, reaching a value just below $10^{-3}$. The visual arrangement shows an initial value of approximately $1.5 \times 10^{-4}$ at index 0, followed by lower values across the early green bars, a localized increase at the blue bars for indices 13 and 14 (between $4 \times 10^{-5}$ and $6 \times 10^{-5}$), and a visually consistent increase in height among the consecutive blue bars from index 19 up to 27. No specific bars are visually emphasized with bolding, outlines, or shading beyond their standard categorical color assignments.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates the Sensitivity across a sequence of Block Indices, categorized by two configurations labeled "4-Fbit" and "2-Fbit". The horizontal categorical axis is labeled "Block Index" and orders the discrete indices sequentially from left to right, displaying tick labels for indices 0, 6, 13, 20, and 27. The vertical value axis is labeled "Sensitivity" and employs a logarithmic scale, with major tick marks and light grey horizontal dashed grid lines at $10^{-5}$, $10^{-4}$, and $10^{-3}$, along with unlabelled minor ticks, covering a range starting from $10^{-5}$ up to $10^{-3}$. A legend in the upper left corner maps blue bars to "4-Fbit" and green bars to "2-Fbit". Each block index is represented by a single vertical bar, colored to indicate its assigned configuration. Index 0 is marked with a blue bar at an approximate value of $1.5 \times 10^{-4}$. Indices 1 through 12 are represented by green bars with values generally ranging between $10^{-5}$ and $3 \times 10^{-5}$, containing the chart's shortest bars around indices 4 and 8 at exactly $10^{-5}$. Indices 13 and 14 appear as blue bars near $5 \times 10^{-5}$, followed by green bars for indices 15 through 18. From index 19 through 27, all bars are blue, demonstrating a progressively increasing sequence of values that culminates in the tallest bar at index 27, which reaches a sensitivity just below $10^{-3}$. The bars are ordered purely by their sequential numerical index, with no additional graphical emphasis or annotations beyond the two-color categorization.
